📖 How to use

  1. Enter the total bill amount.
  2. Tap a quick tip percentage or type your own.
  3. Enter the number of people splitting the bill.
  4. Read the tip amount, total and each person's share.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the tip calculated on the bill before or after tax?

The tip is calculated on the pre-tax bill amount you enter, then added to it. Tax handling varies by country, so this tool keeps it simple: one bill total, one tip.

Can I split the bill evenly between everyone?

Yes — the per-person share divides the bill plus tip equally among everyone at the table.

Is my bill amount sent anywhere?

No, everything is computed in your browser. The bill amount never leaves your device.
